scope: Champions annual weapon collections2021–2026; 2026 attacking/defending original banners and shared kill/fire audio

methods.audio: Download exact wiki originalMP3bytes; decode toverifydurationandPCM. Shared2026originalkill sound mapped toboth themes. Preserve completeRiotAACstreams and verify decoded equality withMP4audio; cut declaredsingle-trigger intervals withtailfade only.
methods.banners: 2021–2023 original frame/ring/emblem/pip PNGs from Kingdom Archives preserve all original dimensions and radial count placement. 2024–2025 use six original count-specific BannerSwap PNGs each. 2026 uses sourceKillBannerData/UMGcount-specific badges, backgrounds and open-state texturelayers; twelve distinct rendered frames retain allsixkillstatesandbothfactions. The runtime originaltransition animationisnot reproduced.
methods.fire2022: This Level 2 preview demonstrates a continuous 30-round automatic burst and a lethal shot. Use only the final trigger and its original natural tail at the end of the non-lethal burst, ending before the next mechanical click. The onset retains quiet reverberation of the preceding burst; no second trigger, kill music or fabricated tail is included. Level 3 and Level 4 previews were also checked and contain lethal shots only.
